purpose: Teach: 聴け/ダラダラ/働け/蹴っ/滑らか/呑み/噛ん/食費

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: おすすめの音楽、聴けば、気分上がる。
lines.en: Good music recommendations really do lift your mood.
lines.style: Light, almost conspiratorial. Quick bright attack. Conversational pace, like she's sharing something she's just discovered. Slight lift at the end—genuine pleasure without performing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お休みの日、家でダラダラ過ごす日も、必要だね。
lines.en: Yeah. Some days off, just lounging at home—you need that.
lines.style: Warm, understanding nod in her voice. Soft opening, steady pace. Gentle acceptance, like she's confirming something they both know. Small pause before 'you need that' — affirming.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今週、働けば働くほど、疲れちゃう。
lines.en: The more I work this week, the more wiped out I get.
lines.style: Slight wry edge underneath. Exhale on the opening. Self-aware but not complaining—almost rueful. Pace slightly slower on the second half, trailing into tired acceptance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 駅で人にぶつかった時、足を蹴っちゃった。
lines.en: Bumped into someone at the station and accidentally kicked their foot.
lines.style: Quiet, a touch embarrassed. Soft entry. Confessional tone, like she's admitting something small but awkward. Pace deliberate, trailing off slightly—still a bit mortified.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お肌、最近、滑らかでうらやましい。
lines.en: Your skin's been looking so smooth lately—I'm jealous.
lines.style: Animated, genuine admiration breaking through. Brighter attack. Playful envy in the tone, not bitter. Light speed, with a small lift of real warmth on the compliment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜の呑み会、最近、控えてる。
lines.en: I've been cutting back on late-night drinking lately.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly uncertain but resolved. Quiet opening. Gentle pace, like she's thinking it through as she speaks. Not defensive—just honest about a small shift in herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ガムを噛んでいると、集中できる。
lines.en: When I'm chewing gum, I can concentrate so much better.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact discovery. Quick, easy rhythm. Light tone—no overthinking, just a simple thing that works. Slight emphasis on 'better' without being emphatic.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今月、食費、上手く抑えられた。
lines.en: I managed to keep my food budget really tight this month.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied. Soft opening, steady pace. Quiet pride—not boastful, just genuinely pleased with herself. Trailing close, like she's wrapping up something good.
